liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Reviewer found Vince's portion dull; they recalled the song from Hartford or Worcester shows [11]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Vocal harmonies at the end of the song are singled out as blissful [8]
- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (1 other source): First played since June 18, 1989 [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **extensive noodling**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **Alabama Getaway**: back after 421 archived shows (2043 days) [17]

## The recordings

- **gd95-02-19.schoeps.10544.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 3/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Average audience recording with little low end and moderately intrusive crowd noise; Audience sing-along is audible and the room sound feels immediate; the recording fades in and out in places [1][8]
- **gd1995-02-19.145490.akg460b.lerond.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 152 min [2]
- **gd1995-02-19.141066.fob.mk4v.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 149 min [3]
- **gd1995-02-19.schoeps.wklitz.95443.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- Bob switches to acoustic guitar for the rest of the set [2]
- Reviewer attended, calling the Delta Center acoustics poor; they were behind the stage on the third night [7]
- Jerry flubbed lyrics while looking at the teleprompter [7]
- Calls the rest of the show typical of 1995 [11]
- Reviewer found 2-21-95 pretty good, but this show plodding and sleepy throughout [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-02-19.schoeps.10544.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by P.B. and Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [1]. Also: A drums-out edit at the end of I Know You Rider was removed using Soundforge 5; Originally tracked on three discs, this version fits on two 80-minute discs [1]
- **gd1995-02-19.145490.akg460b.lerond.t-flac1648**: taped by Jean Lerond; transferred by Jean Lerond; source: AKGC60B+CK8x shotgun in OTS, ~34’ to St.L of C (inline w/hanging PA; aimed at the PA) > Panasonic SV-255 (Paul Tumolo’s rig) Analog or Digi out, possibly via… [2]
- **gd1995-02-19.141066.fob.mk4v.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info:FOB Schoeps MK4V-> Reutelhuber P/S-> Sony D10 Pro II-> DATTransfer Info:Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late… [3]
- **gd1995-02-19.schoeps.wklitz.95443.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps CMC441's>koch power supply >Panasonic sv-255>Sony TCD-D10PROII Recorded by Keith Litzenberger via digital patch from Ed Boardman front Row of Taper's… [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Robbi Cohn: [1995-02-20 Delta Center, Salt Lake City, UT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-02-20-delta-center-salt-lake-city-ut-usa/) [18]
- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Delta Center, Feb 19, 1995 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/DCU950219.html) [19]
- Fan art by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Delta Center, Feb 19, 1995 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/DCU950219-A.html) [20]
